posts.title: Wombat Adds Support for ADB Gamepads and Joysticks
posts.description: It’s time for gaming! Firmware version 3.25 for the BMOW Wombat adds support for ADB game controllers, joysticks, and gamepads, making them available to modern computers. Support includes the popular Gravis Mac GamePad and Gravis MouseStick II, as well as others such as the Gravis Firebird and Blackhawk, Microsoft SideWinder 3D Pro, MacAlly JoyStick, and […]
